The cause was that `logback-classic` 1.2.11 doesn't work with slf4j 2.x. The slf4j `NOPLogger` couldn't be cast to the logback `Logger`, which broke `EventMessageHandlerTest`, and Dropwizard couldn't acquire the logger context, which broke the `ServiceResource*Test` classes. Mockito's "unfinished mocking session" errors in other tests were knock-on failures.

In `pom.xml` I bumped `logback-classic` to 1.3.14 and added explicit `logback-core` and `logback-access` at 1.3.14. Dropwizard 2.0.29 pulls those two in at 1.2.11, and a classic/core version mismatch was why the first attempt with only `logback-classic` bumped still failed.

I didn't touch any tests, enforcer or checkstyle rules, or the Java level.
